title: Departments
description: Your organisation's structure. Departments group people and can scope what administrators are allowed to manage.

tree.label: Organisation tree
tree.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}
tree.noMatchesDescription: Try a different name or code.
tree.emptyDescription: Create your first department to start building the org chart.
tree.people: {count, plural, =0 {no people} one {# person} other {# people}}
tree.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to move through the tree, Enter to select.

detail.selectDescription: Pick a department in the tree to see its details.
detail.deleteBlocked: Move or delete its sub-departments first.

form.createDescription: Add a department to the organisation tree.
form.editDescription: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Short unique identifier. Letters, digits, “-” and “_”.
form.codeTaken: Another department already uses this code.
form.parentHint: Moving a department also moves everything under it.
form.invalidParent: A department can't be placed under itself or one of its sub-departments.
form.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers are listed first among departments with the same parent.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.body: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody belongs to this department.} one {# person in this department will no longer belong to any department.} other {# people in this department will no longer belong to any department.}} Roles scoped to it are revoked. This can't be undone.
delete.hasChildren: “{name}” still has sub-departments. Move or delete them first.
